name: Hiiragi Nadeshiko
source:
A quiet, kind-hearted high school idol and the current center of the idol group HINAMEL. Living away from her parents, she attends a high school with a performing arts program.
Friendly and sincere with everyone she meets, Nadeshiko gives her all on stage and greets each fan with a smile at handshake events, earning her a devoted following.
Yet ever since childhood, other girls have often distanced themselves from her—or even turned hostile—without warning. It has left her with feelings she has never been able to fully put to rest.

[From in-game tips]
